invariants.rationale: HoodieEngineContext is likely required for this operation to proceed, as in most methods in this class.
The rollbackInstantTime String likely identifies an instant and should not be null.
The commitInstant parameter is used to indicate the commit to rollback and should be non-null.
It is probable that rollbackInstantTime should not be the empty string.
deleteInstants is a boolean and should only be true or false.
